key.name: clipper-toggle
key.summary: Shortcut that opens the Clipper panel
key.description: Single-element list of accelerators, as GNOME Shell expects. Editable from the extension's preferences window; Ctrl+Alt+V by default.

key.name: history-limit
key.summary: Maximum number of unpinned items kept in history

key.name: auto-paste
key.summary: Paste selected item into the previously focused window (injects Ctrl+V)

key.name: incognito
key.summary: Incognito: do not record new clipboard items

key.name: hide-on-focus-loss
key.summary: Hide the popup when it loses focus

key.name: theme
key.summary: Panel appearance: system, light or dark
key.description: 'system' follows org.gnome.desktop.interface (color-scheme, and the gtk-theme name on older setups), 'light' and 'dark' pin one palette.

key.name: panel-position
key.summary: Where the panel was last dragged to, 0 0 for "next to the pointer"
key.description: Set by dragging the panel. Zero means the panel is not pinned to a place and opens at the pointer, which is the default.
